walkthroughs.body_html:
When you borrow, you pay interest.

The APR shows the yearly cost.

A credit card at 20% APR means £1,000 owed for a year costs £200 in interest.

Debt types:

  • Mortgage — long, low APR.
  • Student loan — paid back from salary.
  • Credit card — short, high APR.
  • Payday loan — very expensive, avoid.

Tips to stay out of trouble:

  • Only borrow what you can repay.
  • Pay credit cards in full each month.
  • Ignore 'buy now pay later' if you'll forget.
  • Build a good credit score by paying on time.

Default can hurt your record for years. 😬
